newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bid specs for Brazil's Cemig sale due out Friday.
newsitem.headline: Bid specs for Brazil's Cemig sale due out Friday.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) and Minas Gerais state are putting final touches to tender documents to sell off debentures convertible to Minas Gerais power firm Cemig common shares due out Friday, said a Cemig official.
Luiz Fernando Rolla, assistant to the company's chief financial officer, said the tender documents are likely to be sent to Brazil's Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) on Thursday.
BNDES will sell 32.9 percent of Cemig's common stock or 18.7 billion shares, worth over 800 million reais, in a block sale to a strategic partner.
The auction may take place 45 days after the publication of the bid specifications, Rolla said before addressing a conference on Latin American utilities.
Rolla said five foreign groups have shown interest in Cemig, particularly Southern Co of the U.S. and Chile's Enersis SA.
